method: Read-only full LMDB raw byte scan at all eight bit offsets, plus iterative jam literal-atom decoding of EVENTS values after the synthetic account first appears; first four bytes are the runtime mug per stock Vere disk.c. Backreferences refer to already scanned atoms/cells.
limitations: This is evidence for these synthetic credentials and exercised flows, not a proof about arbitrary client actions or encodings.
Earlier kernel boot events are raw-scanned, not decoded.
Owner cookies, authorization codes, access/refresh tokens and encrypted key envelopes remain journaled.
Input-event inspection is distinct from active Gall state inspection.
